items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah, the famous door. Gendley.

ctx.x: I played out here in the quarters. Well, I stayed out here in the quarters. At the Pigpen. I played at the Caliente Club. I played at the Catniff Fiddle. For Hip, it got the famous door.
Oh yeah, the famous door. Gendley.
